【正社員】内部監査担当(業務監査)_リーダー候補（内部監査室）

仕事概要
**コインチェック株式会社について**
---
コインチェックは、2014年より暗号資産取引サービスを提供し、現在では国内トップクラスのダウンロード数を誇るプラットフォームへと成長してきました。2025年現在、暗号資産は「デジタルアセット」としての認識が進み、単なる投資対象から、価値交換・証券化・新たな経済圏の基盤へと変容しつつあります。

私たちはこの社会的な変化を、サービスとして実装するテック集団です。マネックスグループの一員として、高いコンプライアンス水準を守りながらも、新規サービスの立ち上げやブロックチェーン領域への挑戦など、スタートアップ的なスピードと柔軟さをあわせ持つ独自のポジションにあります。

インフラ、セキュリティ、バックエンドといったプロダクトの基盤は、すべて自社開発。数秒単位で価格が動く世界においても、安定かつスケーラブルな体験を提供することは、シンプルながら極めて高度なチャレンジです。こうした技術的課題を楽しめる方が、金融やEC、SaaSなどさまざまな業界からジョインし、活躍しています。

コインチェックが求めているのは、「クリプトに詳しい方」だけではありません。「今は詳しくないけれど、社会構造を変える技術に携わりたい」「未知のドメインに挑戦したい」といった熱量を持つ方を歓迎しています。

私たちと一緒に、次の経済基盤を創り出しませんか？

**配属部署について**
---
配属先：内部監査室
業務執行部門（1線）や間接管理部門（2線）から独立した立場（3線）で、会社の事業活動に対して評価を実施して保証を与える部門です。

**業務内容**
----
**内部監査の計画・実施・報告**
* 年間監査計画の策定、特に金商法に基づく分別管理、最良執行方針、広告規制、情報管理等の金融特有の管理体制に焦点を当てた個別監査テーマの設定。
* 金融業務監査の実施: 顧客資産管理、取引監視、コールドウォレット/ホットウォレット管理、システムリスク管理等、高い専門性が求められる領域の内部統制の有効性評価を行います。
* 監査結果に基づく厳格な改善指摘と、改善施策の提言。
* 監査報告書の作成と経営層および監査役会への報告。

**規制対応とモニタリング**
* 金商法、資金決済法、犯収法等の法規制改正動向の把握と、社内体制への影響評価。
* 専門的レビュー: IT統制、サイバーセキュリティ対策、AML/CFT（反社会的勢力・マネーロンダリング対策）体制に関する専門的監査レビューへの関与。

**担当する業務の魅力**
---
* 取締役会直轄の部門であり、監査結果は取締役会への報告となることから、会社経営に密接に関わる立場で仕事ができること
* 金融機関としての各種レギュレーションを遵守しつつ、業界の環境変化に柔軟に対応する必要があることから、リスクに対して真摯に向き合った監査が実施できること
* 新規サービスの提供や、内部統制の高度化を進めていることから、新しく監査対象となる業務に対して監査手続をゼロベースで構築するケースも相応にあり、多様な経験を積むことができること
* DX化が進む社会環境において、いち早くデジタルベースであるFintech企業で監査人としての経験を積むことができること

**チーム構成**
---
* 室長（40代男性）
* メンバー：1名（40代女性）
* 他業務委託メンバー

**選考フロー**
---
**書類選考 → 1次面接 → 2次面接 → 最終面接**
※選考状況により、フローが一部変更となる場合がございます。

- ご希望やご状況に合わせて、選考ステップの短縮やスピード調整も可能です。
- 「まずは話を聞きたい」という方には、選考前にカジュアル面談を実施することも可能です。
- 最終面接前に、相互理解を深めるための人事面談（合否不問）をご案内する場合がございます。
- 2次面接は原則対面を予定しております。

Who We Are
NEXT Ventures is a global fintech group building products that empower traders worldwide. Our portfolio includes FundedNext, a leading proprietary trading firm, and FNmarkets, a CFD brokerage. With teams across Malaysia, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Cyprus and Dubai, we move fast, think boldly and build technology trusted by traders around the world.
Your Role in Our Mission
As SQA Lead, you will own software quality across our trading platforms, dashboards and payment flows. You will build and lead the QA function, set the testing strategy, and make sure every release is stable, secure and ready for traders who depend on us in real time. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product and DevOps to make quality part of how we build, not a gate at the end.
How You'll Make an Impact
•
Define and own the end-to-end QA strategy, standards and processes across web, mobile and API products.
•
Lead, mentor and grow a team of manual and automation QA engineers; set goals, review work and build capability.
•
Design and scale test automation frameworks (UI, API, regression) and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines.
•
Drive functional, regression, integration, performance and security testing for high-volume, real-time trading systems.
•
Own release readiness: test planning, go/no-go criteria, defect triage and post-release quality reviews.
•
Define and report quality metrics (defect leakage, test coverage, automation rate, escaped bugs) to engineering leadership.
•
Work with Product and Engineering on acceptance criteria and shift-left testing from the requirement stage.
•
Evaluate and introduce QA tools that improve speed, coverage and reliability.
What You Bring
•
7+ years in software quality assurance, including 2+ years leading a QA team.
•
Strong hands-on experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright or Appium.
•
Solid API testing experience with Postman, REST Assured or similar.
•
Experience embedding automated tests into CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar).
•
Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or Java).
•
Experience with performance and load testing tools such as JMeter, k6 or Gatling.
•
Working knowledge of SQL for data validation.
•
Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery and test management tools (Jira, Xray, TestRail or similar).
•
Clear communicator who can push back on releases with data, not opinion.
X-Factor
•
Experience testing fintech, trading, brokerage or payment platforms.
•
Familiarity with trading platforms or APIs such as MT4/MT5, cTrader or Match-Trader.
•
Exposure to security testing (OWASP) and compliance-driven QA.
•
ISTQB or equivalent certification.
•
Experience building a QA function from the ground up in a fast-growing company.
Your Journey
•
Initial screening call
•
Technical interview with Engineering leadership
•
Final interview with senior leadership
Why Join NEXT
•
Own quality for products used by traders around the world.
•
Build and shape a QA function with real influence on how we ship.
•
Work with a diverse, multinational team across five countries.
•
Competitive compensation and benefits.
•
A culture that rewards ownership, speed and continuous learning.

At INGOT, we believe in building high-performing teams where everyone is in the right seat – not just filling a role but thriving in it. Our approach emphasizes getting the right people in the right positions to drive business growth and success.

Here’s what that means for YOU:

• You’ll excel at what you do because you’re in a role that aligns with your skills and passions

• You’ll be aligned with our core values - High Ethics, Commitment and Innovation – we’re looking for team members who get it, want it, and have the capacity to do it

• We want you to thrive in an environment where your contributions matter, and you can make an impact on our mission.

If you’re a high-energy, results-driven professional who’s ready to take on a role that matches your expertise and values, we’d love to connect! Check out the details below and see if this is the right fit for you.

Purpose of Role/Summary:

The Junior Multimedia Graphic Designer will support the Design and Marketing teams in creating engaging visual content across digital, social media, video, motion graphics, presentations, campaigns, events, and internal communication.

The role requires a good understanding of Adobe Creative Suite, basic multimedia production skills, strong visual awareness, and practical knowledge of AI-powered creative tools. The selected candidate should be willing to learn, experiment with new technologies, and use AI responsibly to improve creative exploration and production efficiency.

Main Activities and Responsibilities:

•

• Create social media posts, digital advertisements, website visuals, banners, presentations, email graphics, and campaign materials

• Adapt approved designs into different formats, dimensions, languages, and platforms

• Follow INGOT’s brand guidelines and maintain consistency across all visual materials

• Prepare artwork and production-ready files for digital and print use

• Support the team with image editing, retouching, compositing, and visual enhancements

Multimedia and Motion Design

• Create basic motion graphics, animated social media content, video transitions, and promotional videos

• Edit short-form videos for social media, campaigns, events, and internal communication

• Add typography, music, sound effects, subtitles, and basic animation to video content

• Assist senior designers and motion designers with larger multimedia projects

• Organize project files, footage, design assets, and final exports

AI-Assisted Creative Production

• Use AI tools to support concept development, brainstorming, mood boards, storyboards, image generation, video exploration, and design variations

• Write and refine prompts to achieve more accurate and brand-relevant creative results

• Enhance AI-generated outputs using Adobe applications before using them in final designs

• Review AI-generated content for visual quality, accuracy, originality, brand suitability, and potential errors

• Follow company policies regarding confidential information, copyrighted materials, licensing, and responsible AI use

• Stay updated on emerging AI tools and identify practical opportunities to improve the team’s workflow

Collaboration and Workflow

• Work closely with designers, content creators, marketing team members, and other stakeholders

• Receive feedback professionally and apply requested amendments accurately

• Manage assigned tasks according to priorities, deadlines, and project requirements

• Participate in brainstorming sessions, design reviews, and team meetings

Submit completed work to the Head of Design or assigned senior team member for quality review before final delivery

Required Skills & Experience:

• Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent qualification in Graphic Design, Multimedia Design, Visual Communication, Animation, or a related field

• Fresh graduate or up to two (2) years of relevant professional, internship, or freelance experience

• Strong portfolio demonstrating graphic design, digital content creation, multimedia, motion graphics, and/or video editing

• Good understanding of design principles, including layout, typography, color theory, composition, visual hierarchy, and branding

• Good command of English; Arabic is an advantage

• Interest in financial markets, fintech, digital marketing, or trading-related content is considered a plus

Technical Skills:

• Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe After Effects, Adobe Acrobat, and Microsoft PowerPoint

• Knowledge of Figma, Adobe Firefly, AI image-generation tools, AI video-generation tools, AI-assisted editing and upscaling tools, Cinema 4D, Blender, or other 3D software is considered an advantage

AI Knowledge:

• Understand the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools

• Create effective prompts for generating images, videos, creative concepts, and design variations

• Use reference images and art direction to guide AI-generated outputs

• Identify and correct common AI-generated visual errors

• Integrate AI-generated assets into Adobe Creative Cloud workflows

• Review, verify, and refine AI-generated content before publications

• Use AI tools responsibly and avoid uploading confidential company, employee, or customer information to unauthorized platforms

• Demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to learn and adopt emerging AI-powered creative workflows.

Core Competencies

• Creativity and strong visual thinking

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality

• Strong time management and organizational skills

• Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines

• Ability to work within established brand guidelines

Manage high-priority and escalated customer cases in collaboration with offshore agents and local teams.

Liaise with Customer Due Diligence (CDD) teams to improve KYC/AML workflows for customers and reduce customer friction.

Act as SME for OKX Card support operations — guiding offshore CS on dispute handling, chargeback processes, and cardholder issue resolution in line with card program compliance requirements.

Work closely with Product and Marketing teams to proactively inform CS of upcoming campaigns, changes, or product launches that may drive ticket volume.

•

Identify operational pain points in the customer journey and work cross-functionally to resolve or escalate them.

•

Develop SOPs, quick guides, and training materials to help offshore agents respond more effectively to users.

•

Track key CS metrics such as resolution time, CSAT, and escalation volume to measure success and identify improvement areas.

•

If the business moves toward a local CS team in the future, help scope, plan, and build this function from the ground up.

Solid understanding of US financial regulation, consumer protection expectations, and AML/KYC processes.

Experience working with or leading offshore support teams in a high-growth or regulated environment.

•

Exposure to customer-centric operations functions — blending support, risk, compliance, and product feedback loops.

•

Strong leadership and coaching ability, with a focus on raising offshore team performance without direct line management.

•

Excellent stakeholder management skills — ability to work across compliance, product, marketing, and support teams.

•

Operationally minded — you're a problem-solver who can turn user pain points into action plans.

•

Process-driven — capable of designing and implementing SOPs and knowledge base content.

Excellent communicator — able to distill regulatory complexity into practical CS guidance.

Summary:

The Senior Manager, Privacy Program is a strategic leader of user data integrity and technical governance at Topstep. In a dynamic financial environment where sensitive personal and trading data is paramount, this role is critical to maintaining our status as the most trusted platform.

You will be responsible for building, leading, and maturing a world-class privacy and technical governance program from the ground up. Beyond setting the enterprise-wide strategy to satisfy global regulatory obligations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), you will directly manage a specialized team consisting of a Technical Governance & Operational Readiness Manager and a Privacy Operations Manager.

Under your leadership, your team will seamlessly integrate Privacy by Design principles into our products, execute day-to-day data subject requests (DSARs), and implement automated, continuous audit readiness for IT governance (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001). This role is foundational to scaling Topstep responsibly, automating compliance workflows, and defending our hard-earned reputation.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Operational Oversight

• People Management: Direct, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of privacy and technical governance professionals. Set clear OKRs, conduct performance reviews, and foster a culture of continuous operational improvement.

• Function Integration: Seamlessly bridge the daily execution of privacy operations (DSARs, vendor reviews) with broader technical IT governance initiatives (automated control monitoring, audit readiness).

• SLA & Metric Management: Establish and monitor team KPIs, ensuring strict adherence to statutory timelines for privacy requests and maintaining real-time visibility into technical control health and framework alignment for executive reporting.

Privacy Program Strategy & Governance

Since our inception in 2018, Busha has been at the forefront of digital currency exchange, offering trading options in cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum. Our mission is to build an open financial system characterized by innovation, efficiency, and user-friendliness. We value Clear Communication, Positive Energy, Efficient Execution, and Continuous Learning in all our team members.

At Busha, we are building technology that makes financial services more accessible, efficient and reliable. Busha Pro is our spot exchange for crypto and fiat, where speed, reliability and security are essential to delivering a seamless trading experience for our users.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to work on the engineering behind a live exchange where speed, reliability and accuracy matter.

You will take ownership of and improve the systems responsible for processing orders, matching trades and supporting exchange operations: operating them in production, making them faster and extending them safely.

Overview

We are looking for someone who understands more than just writing code. You should understand how trading systems work, how to build them reliably at scale and how to solve the technical challenges that come with real-time transactions.

You will have meaningful ownership of technical decisions, shape the platform's architecture and work closely with the wider team to turn product requirements into reliable, production-ready systems.

Responsibilities

• Take ownership of the Busha Pro exchange: learn the codebase deeply, operate it in production and harden it.
• Design, build and optimize the backend systems that power Busha Pro’s trading capabilities.
• Develop and improve matching engine components, order books, order processing and trade execution workflows. Keep matching deterministic and consistent under peak load, with no crossed books, ghost fills or stale order state.
• Build reliable systems that can handle high transaction volumes while maintaining speed, accuracy and consistency.
• Work on APIs (REST, WebSocket, and later FIX), real-time market data, event-driven services and integrations that connect different parts of the trading platform.
• Improve system performance, reduce latency and identify bottlenecks before they become production issues. Benchmark and profile the matching path, load-test against realistic traffic and measure every change against a baseline.
• Build safeguards that help maintain accurate order processing, transaction integrity and reliable system recovery: pre-trade risk checks, price bands, circuit breakers, kill switches, failover and disaster recovery.
• Keep the ledger exact: trades and fees settled atomically, real-time balances, and crypto and fiat deposits and withdrawals reconciled against custody and banking records.
• Add trading pairs, order types (such as OCO, take-profit and stop-loss) and features, released with zero downtime.
• Analyze business product requirements and propose effective technical solutions.
• Write clean, testable and maintainable code, and participate in code reviews and technical design discussions. Test matching and ledger invariants with simulation and replay.
• Take ownership of features from design and implementation through testing, deployment and ongoing monitoring.
• Share the on-call rotation for production trading systems.
• Collaborate with Product, Engineering and DevOps to deliver key technical priorities.
• Share your knowledge, support other engineers and contribute to strong engineering practices.

What We're Looking For

• 5–7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development experience.
• Strong in Go, or strong in Rust, C++ or Java and willing to work primarily in Go.

• Hands-on experience building, operating or improving trading systems, exchange infrastructure, matching engines or comparable real-time transaction-processing platforms.
• A solid understanding of order books, order lifecycles, matching logic and trade execution.
• Experience building systems where performance, concurrency, reliability and data consistency are critical, including idempotency, exactly-once processing and recovery from partial failures.
• Experience working on systems that require low latency, high availability and predictable execution under heavy load.
• Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, databases and distributed systems.
• Experience designing APIs, event-driven services and scalable backend architectures.
• Good judgment in an existing codebase: you improve a live system in small, safe steps rather than reaching for a rewrite.
• Performance work grounded in measurement: profiling, latency percentiles (p99 and above), and memory and garbage-collection tuning.
• Working knowledge of Linux internals (threading, CPU and NUMA effects, system calls) and TCP/UDP networking.
• A practical approach to testing, debugging, performance optimisation and production reliability, including testing that proves correctness through simulation, fuzzing or replaying production traffic.
• You've run what you built in production, including on-call and incident response, and can debug across the OS, network and application layers.
• The ability to take ownership of complex technical work and deliver it with minimal supervision.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical decisions clearly.

Requirements

• Experience at a cryptocurrency exchange, financial trading platform or electronic market.
• Familiarity with risk controls, settlement or market data infrastructure.
• Crypto infrastructure: wallets, custody, blockchain nodes, deposit and withdrawal pipelines.
• Fiat payment rails: bank transfers, local payment networks, settlement and reconciliation.
• The FIX protocol, event sourcing, or low-latency patterns such as the LMAX Disruptor.
• Experience with market surveillance, regulatory reporting or audits at a regulated venue.
• TypeScript/Node.js for services, gateways or internal tools around the engine.

What Success Looks Like

You'll help us build trading systems that are reliable, performant and ready to scale. You'll take ownership of important engineering deliverables, improve the quality of our infrastructure and help ensure that orders and trades are processed accurately and efficiently.

We value engineers who are proactive, thoughtful in their technical decisions and comfortable taking responsibility for the systems they build.

Why Join Busha?

At Busha, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging financial technology, influence important engineering decisions and help shape the infrastructure behind Busha Pro.

If you enjoy solving complex backend problems, building performance-sensitive systems and working on technology where reliability and precision genuinely matter, we'd love to hear from you.

You’re going to fix that.

We’re seeking a hands-on Head of Organic Growth to own how Kraken Pro gets discovered and how curious traders become active ones. At Kraken, understanding our brand ethos, mission, and the traders we serve is essential. Organic is where brand and acquisition meet.

We’re looking for a player-coach who moves fast but thinks long-term, gets in the weeds while leading from the front, and knows that traffic means nothing if it doesn’t convert. This role demands sharp B2C acquisition instincts, a product-first mindset, an obsession with UX, and a self-starter attitude.

 - Own organic acquisition. Build and run the strategy across SEO, content, social, community, referrals, and partnerships to bring high-intent traders to Kraken Pro.

 - Find out if people convert. Map the funnel from first touch to first trade, report on it clearly, and figure out where traders drop off and how to win them back.

 - Make UX your edge. Work with Product and Design to audit and improve landing pages, sign-up flows, onboarding, and in-product moments. Great acquisition dies in bad UX, and you know it.

 - Acquire through brand. Make every growth channel a brand-building one. Reach is easy to buy; trust is what makes traders stay.

 - Know the product cold. Use Kraken Pro like a trader would, understand what makes it better, and turn those strengths into growth levers.

 - Lead a lean, scrappy team. Set direction, coach, and unblock a small team, while staying hands-on enough to ship, test, and fix things yourself.

 - Test and learn. Run experiments across channels and funnel steps, double down on what works, and kill what doesn’t.

 - Report what matters. Build clear dashboards and insights that show leadership what’s driving growth, what isn’t, and what to do next.

 - Ship responsibly. Partner with Legal/Comms to ensure compliant, accurate, and aligned messaging across regions and platforms.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5+ years in B2C acquisition or growth marketing, ideally in fintech, crypto, trading or gaming with experience in a player-coach role leading a small team.

 - Product savvy. You understand how products work, why people use them, and how to turn features into growth.

 - UX instinct. You can spot friction in a flow from a mile away and brief Product and Design on how to fix it.

 - High AI competency. Enabling you to multiply your impact and keep up with demand.

 - Analytical rigor. Comfortable with funnels, cohorts, attribution, and experimentation, and able to turn data into decisions and clear stories.

 - Speed under pressure. Markets don’t wait for approval cycles and neither do you.

 - Range as a marketer. SEO, content, social, lifecycle, partnerships. You know enough about each to direct the work, and you can roll up your sleeves when needed.

 - Taste. Knowing which channels and tactics not to pursue is as valuable as knowing which to scale.

 - Familiarity trading culture, and the language traders use.

 - Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams around a shared growth goal.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.



 


THE TEAM

Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, brand design, motion design, AI video creative and web design. We turn growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, and we hold the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

As our Staff Brand Designer, you come to the table with a strong design vision and set the visual standard for Kraken. You design static work for launches, campaigns and always-on activity, and you make sure it looks like one brand wherever someone meets it. You can take a brief or proactive idea to a finished, approved asset set, and you're comfortable building a clean, systemized layout in Figma. If you can also model and render a hero 3D asset in Cinema 4D, that's a real bonus.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and ownership: you set the bar for brand quality on the team, you build systems others can work from, and you're the person colleagues come to with design questions.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design static creative for Kraken across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

 - Apply and extend the Kraken Consumer brand across surfaces, from organic social, lifecycle and web to illustration and foundational projects like key visual updates, keeping everything cohesive and recognizable without making it repetitive.

 - Design initiative-specific work, including a distinct look and partner-branded assets for launches, and purpose-built illustration for go-to-market and product moments.

 - Build scalable systems: Figma component libraries, marketing templates and modular campaign kits with localization-ready layouts, so other designers, other teams and our automated workflows can produce on-brand work quickly.

 - Use AI-assisted production as a core part of how the brand gets made, and know when it speeds the work up and when it doesn't.

 - Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Push back with a point of view when a brief is unclear or the idea can be stronger.

 - Version and localize work across markets, languages and formats, with layouts that hold up under translation and market-specific requirements.

 - Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

 - Collaborate closely with our motion, web, performance and AI video designers so work travels well across formats.

 - Hold a high craft bar on your own work and give clear, constructive feedback on others'.

 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 7+ years of brand and static design experience at a high-volume in-house team or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto or another regulated category (a competitor or similar company is a big plus).

 - A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Include the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. We'd like to see brand and static work, an example of work you adapted for multiple formats or markets, and an example of a system or template set that other people built from. If you have 3D work, include a piece with a short note on your process.

 - Expert-level Figma: components, auto layout, variables, and files that are easy to hand off and build on.

 - Strong layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at small sizes and in multiple languages.

 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted production tools, and good judgment about where they belong in a workflow.

 - Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, including layouts that accommodate risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements without compromising the design.

 - Working fluency in Adobe CC (Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects for light motion).

 - Speed without sloppiness. You're comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

 - A solid instinct for plain language and clear communication: value first, no hype, no jargon.

 - Curious about investing and crypto at a minimum, and able to make the space legible to others.

Kraken and Payward VIP team supports the firm’s highest-value private clients: high-net-worth individuals who expect a premium, secure, and deeply tailored experience. We ensure Kraken remains the exchange of choice for VIPs through white-glove relationship management, personalized trading enablement, and high-impact benefits.

We are looking for a Head of VIP, Asia to lead and grow Payward VIP presence across the region. This is a player-coach role: you will build and lead a small, high-performing team while personally owning strategic client relationships, originating new business, and shaping the regional growth playbook.

You will set the standard for how Kraken serves, retains, and grows its most valuable private clients in Asia. You will be equally comfortable in a senior client meeting, building an introducer network, coaching a relationship manager, hosting a VIP event, and partnering internally to remove the product or operational barriers that cost us high-value business.

Payward VIP program is unique, and we intend to keep it that way. We don’t copy what other exchanges and desks do. You’ll take what makes our program different and adapt it to how Asia’s VIP clients actually trade, network, and build trust. That means testing new ideas, learning fast, dropping what doesn’t work, and scaling what does. If you’re bold, comfortable with ambiguity, and humble enough to fail fast and move on, this is your seat.

 
 


THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Lead, coach, and develop VIP relationship managers in Asia; establish clear standards for client coverage, pipeline management, service quality, and commercial performance.

 - Build the operating model for VIP growth across Asia, including territory coverage, account segmentation, referral strategy, events, and performance reporting.

 - Own regional AOP growth, net deposits, client assets, trading volume, retention, and revenue performance.

 - Build a repeatable pipeline of qualified high-value clients through direct outreach, referrals, introducers, family offices, proprietary trading firms, OTC desks, miners, project treasuries, and high-volume traders.

 - Represent the voice of Asia’s VIP client base internally: identify competitive threats, regional market dynamics, product gaps, and opportunities that influence where private-client capital trades.




PERSONALLY OWN STRATEGIC CLIENT RELATIONSHIPS

 - Own and grow Kraken's most strategically important private client relationships across Asia, bringing our full VIP offering - ranging from trading and asset management to other services - to market locally, within Kraken's compliance and risk framework.

 - Serve as the senior relationship owner for Kraken’s largest and most strategically important private clients across Asia.

 - Bring Kraken’s VIP and private-client offering to market locally, including spot, margin, futures, OTC execution, earn and yield opportunities, lending, and tailored benefits.

 - Build trusted, durable relationships while ensuring every client interaction and commercial initiative operates within Kraken’s licensing, compliance, and risk framework.


BUILD REGIONAL PRESENCE AND PARTNERSHIPS

 - Develop Kraken’s presence in Asia’s VIP trading and investor communities, including private trading groups, investor clubs, KOL and trader networks, and closed-door investor circles.

 - Design and lead high-quality regional programming, including VIP dinners, trader meetups, conference-adjacent events, and partner activations, in collaboration with Marketing and Regional teams.

 - Build and manage introducer and referral partnerships that create a durable source of qualified VIP opportunities.

 - Partner with Product, Marketing, Compliance, Banking, Client Service, and Operations to launch regional growth initiatives and improve the client experience.

 
 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 7+ years of experience in VIP relationship management, private banking, brokerage, private-client sales, account management, or business development, including meaningful experience in crypto or digital assets.

 - Demonstrated people leadership experience, with the judgment and practical coaching ability to lead a small team while remaining hands-on with strategic clients and revenue opportunities.

 - A strong personal network among Asia’s crypto HNWIs, traders, family offices, OTC desks, funds, or trading communities. Experience across Greater China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, or Singapore is especially valuable.

 - A proven record of personally originating and converting new business, not solely servicing an existing client book.

 - Deep knowledge of crypto market structure and trading solutions, including spot, margin, futures, OTC, lending, tokenized equities, and yield/earn products.

 - Strong commercial judgment and comfort managing KPIs including assets on platform, net deposits, revenue, trading volume, retention, pipeline conversion, and client portfolio growth.

 - Native or near-native Mandarin and fluent English.

 - Comfort operating across multiple regulated Asian jurisdictions, with sound judgment on when to engage Compliance and Risk partners early.

 - Willingness to travel up to 30% across the region for strategic client meetings, events, and conferences.

Google Cloud Platform

Prometheus stack

Job Description
As part of its ongoing organisational evolution, Swissquote is creating a new department, the Client Lifecycle Integrity (CLI) Department. Acting as a 1.5 line of defence and independent from the Front Office, the CLI brings together key activities supporting the integrity-related management of private client relationships throughout their lifecycle, from onboarding and periodic reviews to AML transaction monitoring.
In this context, the Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will play a key leadership role in shaping and implementing the new organisation. As a member of Senior Management and Director, the role is responsible for defining the CLI’s strategic direction, establishing an effective and forward-looking operating model, driving a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence and ensuring the successful integration and performance of its different activities, in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and internal policies. The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity shall in particular have a strong focus on technology enablement, AI-driven optimisation and operational scalability, with a strong client-centric and data-driven approach.
The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will act as a senior partner to the Executive Management and work closely with the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department as well as technology functions to continuously enhance the Bank’s integrity-related client lifecycle framework.

Key responsibilities:
1. Leadership, Governance & Stakeholder Management
• Lead the CLI, defining its strategy, organisation, governance and priorities, and establishing clear accountability across the department.
• Establish and maintain a strong, risk-based control environment, ensuring that all activities within the CLI’s remit are effective, consistent and compliant with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank’s risk tolerance.
• Provide senior leadership and direction on complex or sensitive cases and operational matters, driving appropriate escalation and decision-making.
• Represent the CLI at Senior Management and in relevant governance bodies, and act as a strategic partner to the Executive Management, the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department and other key stakeholders.
• Serve as a senior point of contact for FINMA, auditors and other relevant external stakeholders within the CLI’s area of responsibility.
• Drive high standards, quality and effectiveness across the different CLI activities, supported by appropriate policies, procedures, controls, management information and risk and performance indicators.
• Ensure timely reporting of key risk and performance indicators to the Executive Management and relevant governance bodies.
• Build and develop a high-performing management team and foster a culture of strong control, collaboration and operational excellence.
• Contribute to the preparation of external and internal audits, inspections as well as regulatory reviews.
2. Client Onboarding, Integrity-related Lifecycle Management & AML Transaction Monitoring
• Oversee private client onboarding (incl. with respect to prospects introduced or managed by Group foreign entities), in line with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank’s risk tolerance.
• Oversee integrity-related lifecycle activities, including periodic and event-driven reviews, changes in circumstances, account maintenance, dormant account processes and closures, ensuring compliant and efficient execution.
• Oversee AML transaction monitoring across all client segments, ensuring effective identification, assessment and escalation of potentially suspicious activities.
• Ensure appropriate risk management and robust governance for complex or high-risk client relationships and transactions, while maintaining effective collaboration with Front Office and the Compliance Department.
3. Process Effectiveness, Automation & Continuous Improvement
• Continuously enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CLI processes, with a focus on optimisation, automation and digitalisation.
• Identify and implement opportunities to leverage technology, data, analytics, workflow solutions and AI to reduce manual activities, improve quality, consistency and risk effectiveness and ensure compliance.
• Establish and monitor appropriate operational and quality metrics to identify performance gaps, assess outcomes and support informed management decisions.
• Work closely with technology functions as well as other relevant stakeholders to deliver sustainable improvements across client onboarding, integrity-related lifecycle management and AML transaction monitoring as well as anticipate and adapt to the evolving client onboarding and lifecycle landscapes.
• Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging teams to challenge existing ways of working and identify practical opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and control effectiveness.

Qualifications
• 10+ years of professional experience in a leadership position in Operations, Compliance, AML, Risk Management or similar functions within a banking, financial services or fintech environment.
• Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Law, Business Administration or equivalent degree.
• Proven track record in process optimisation, automation, digitalisation and operational excellence.
• A relevant certification in project management, process improvement or transformation (e.g. PMP) is considered an asset.
• Strong understanding of how data, technology, workflow tools and AI can be used to enhance control effectiveness, decision-making and operational efficiency.
• Strong expertise in client onboarding, KYC/AML, client lifecycle management and AML transaction monitoring, with a broad understanding of related legal and regulatory requirements.
• Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities, particularly when dealing with complex or high-impact regulatory and operational matters.
• Demonstrated experience managing and developing large and diverse teams, with a strong track record of building high-performing management structures, developing talent and leadership capabilities, and establishing effective career development and succession planning frameworks.
• Past exposure to Executive Management, regulators, auditors and senior internal stakeholders.
• High level of integrity, sound judgement and professional credibility, combined with strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative leadership approach.
• Native French or English speaker, with full professional fluency in the other language.

Role Overview

This is a hands-on, full-cycle role that owns the whole fraud control loop: investigate, analyze, set up rules, monitor, and improve. You will work tickets daily, turn what you find into data-backed fraud rules and strategies, monitor how they perform, and keep refining them. Each stage feeds the next.

You will own the card risk control strategy, from set-up through ongoing performance, and be accountable for the fraud rate and the interception rate.

Key Responsibilities

1. Investigation

•

Handle card risk tickets daily: review rule-triggered alerts, investigate suspicious accounts and transactions, and decide on block, decline, step-up, or card-lifecycle actions within SLA

•

Investigate fraud typologies: account takeover, card testing, BIN attacks, merchant collusion, friendly fraud, and first-party abuse

•

Assess merchant and transaction risk by MCC risk type, including high-risk merchants and non-card payment flows

•

Manage disputes and chargebacks end to end under Visa/Mastercard rules: evidence, representation, pre-arbitration, and arbitration

2. Data Analysis

•

Turn investigation findings into patterns: analyze ticket, alert, and transaction data to identify fraud trends, attack vectors, and coverage gaps

•

Measure false positives against loss to judge whether existing rules are effective

3. Rule Set-up

•

Design and set up fraud rules, velocity limits, and strategies based on the analysis

•

Make sure rule triggers and decisions stay compliant; escalate linked AML/sanctions concerns to Compliance

4. Rule Monitoring

•

Continuously monitor alert and ticket data after rules go live

•

Track and report KPIs: fraud loss rate (bps), chargeback ratio, approval rate, alert handling time, recovery rate

•

Keep the programme within scheme monitoring thresholds (e.g. VAMP, ECM/EFM) and support scheme and partner audits

5. Rule Improvement

•

Adjust, retire, and add rules in response to monitoring results, balancing fraud loss against false positives and approval rate

•

Feed fraud trends back to Product and Engineering to improve onboarding, 3DS, and authorisation controls

Requirements

•

3+ years in card fraud strategy or payments risk at an issuer, EMI, neobank, PSP, or card programme manager

•

Proven hands-on experience building and tuning fraud rules and strategies, not only working tickets

•

Hands-on knowledge of Visa and/or Mastercard dispute rules, reason codes, and chargeback timelines

•

Experience with MCC-based risk, high-risk merchants, and non-card payments

•

Strong data skills: SQL and Excel/Sheets to pull, slice, and explain fraud trends

•

Fluent English; Mandarin or other European languages are a plus

Nice to Have

•

Crypto-linked or prepaid/debit card programme experience, including crypto-to-fiat conversion at authorisation

•

Card risk control experience across multiple countries/regions

•

Experience launching a card programme in a new market or with a new BIN sponsor

•

Scheme monitoring programme remediation experience

•

Python or BI tooling (Looker, Tableau, Metabase)

•

Certifications: CFE, ACAMS, or equivalent

About the Job

We are looking for a Salesforce Business Analyst to play a central role in our move from a legacy CRM to Salesforce. At IC, Salesforce is where our sales, retention, partner, compliance and support teams work every day, and the rules behind it are rich: who owns a client depends on their region, how they joined and whether they trade or introduce others, and what each team can see depends on role and regulated entity. You will be the bridge between those teams and our developers and QA, turning how the business really works into clear user stories, sound process and access designs, and an org people want to use. If you enjoy untangling complex processes, asking the question nobody has asked yet and seeing a requirement through to UAT, we’d like to hear from you.

What you’ll own

• Run workshops, interviews and process walkthroughs with Sales, Partners, Compliance and Support to understand how work is really done.

• Map current and future-state processes for the CRM migration, from sign-up through onboarding to trading, and identify gaps against the legacy system.

• Write clear user stories with acceptance criteria in Jira, plus BDD scenarios or specifications where a story needs more detail, traceable from business goal to delivered feature.

• Work with the Product Owner, Salesforce Architect, developers and QA to shape scalable solutions that follow Salesforce best practice.

• Contribute to defining data models, assignment rules and access requirements with the Salesforce technical team.

• Plan data migration with the technical team: field mapping, data quality rules and validation of migrated records.

• Maintain process documentation, data dictionaries, user guides and training materials, and drive user adoption after each release.

• Define and run test cases for system, integration and user acceptance testing, support production validation, and triage issues with QA and developers through to root cause.

• Use AI tools such as Claude to draft BRDs, stories and UAT scenarios and to surface edge cases, checking every output before it is used.

• Identify where automation or AI agents could remove manual work for sales and support teams.

• Define how success is measured, such as handling time, manual touches and conversion, and track it after release.

• Run demos and status updates, and communicate progress, risks and dependencies to management.

What you’ll need

Essential

• 5+ years as a Salesforce Business Analyst.

• Proven experience on a CRM migration or system transformation project.

• Strong knowledge of the Salesforce data model and core clouds, especially Sales and Service Cloud.

• Salesforce Administrator, Sales Cloud and Service Cloud Consultant certification.

• User stories, acceptance criteria and process flows that developers and testers can work from without guessing.

• A working understanding of Salesforce security: profiles, permission sets, roles and sharing.

• Experience in trading or financial services: client onboarding, partner management or compliance workflows.

• Agile/Scrum delivery with Jira.

• Effective prompting of AI tools such as Claude, including AI-assisted test case design for UAT.

Desirable

• A business analysis certification, such as Salesforce Certified Business Analyst, IIBA CBAP or CCBA, or PMI-PBA

• Data migration projects and large data sets, including Data Loader or similar tools

• Agentforce and AI-powered automation: defining agent use cases and taking them through UAT

• Brokerage or fintech experience: KYC/AML, trading account types, MT4, MT5 or cTrader, IB models

• Process modelling in tools such as Miro, Lucidchart or Visio

• Basic SQL or SOQL and Postman, to check data and API payloads yourself

• Multi-region, multi-language orgs

OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Product Manager with a deep understanding of TradingView users, strong commercial judgment, and experience driving product growth. You will grow OKX's business within the TradingView ecosystem by identifying the most promising customer segments, defining why traders should choose OKX, and finding effective ways to acquire, activate, and retain them, with accountability for measurable business outcomes.

Your first priority is to establish how the business can grow and which opportunities warrant investment. You will validate growth hypotheses through user research, data analysis, and focused experiments before committing substantial engineering resources. Those insights will shape the product roadmap, investment priorities, and the TradingView integrations and trading experience improvements you deliver with engineering and partners.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Define the Growth Strategy and Business Opportunity —

Identify high-potential customer segments, trading use cases, and market opportunities within the TradingView ecosystem. Assess competitive positioning, platform selection drivers, and OKX's differentiated value proposition. Build growth hypotheses and business cases that consider audience size, revenue potential, acquisition cost, and expected return, then set business goals, priorities, and a phased growth plan.

• Understand Users and the Trading Conversion Journey —

Use interviews, behavioral data, and community feedback to understand how traders discover platforms, use charts and indicators, set alerts, connect accounts, place orders, and manage positions. Identify what motivates or prevents users from choosing OKX, making their first trade, and returning. Develop customer segments and conversion funnels, and turn insights into clear product, positioning, and lifecycle opportunities.

• Validate Growth Hypotheses and Improve Conversion and Retention —

Design measurable experiments across acquisition, account connection, first successful trade, repeat trading, and reactivation. Use existing capabilities, onboarding, trader education, value proposition testing, and targeted campaigns to validate opportunities. Define success metrics, experiment costs, and criteria to scale or stop; expand approaches that work and use the evidence to inform subsequent product investment.

• Drive Go-To-Market and Ecosystem Partnerships —

Work with marketing, regional, lifecycle, and TradingView partner teams on acquisition and go-to-market plans. Evaluate ecosystem visibility, communities, creators, educational content, and joint campaigns as potential channels. Define the customer proposition, distribution approach, conversion journey, and partner objectives, and assess channels by the active traders, retention, and business contribution they generate.

• Translate Growth Evidence into Product Delivery and Integration —

Translate validated user needs and growth opportunities into a product roadmap, PRDs, and acceptance criteria. Define the minimum scope and engineering priorities required to achieve the business objective. Work with OKX engineering and TradingView technical teams to assess API integration, account authorization, market data, and order and position synchronization, and drive the necessary adaptation, testing, and launch to address specific conversion, trust, or retention problems.

• Own Business Outcomes and Continuously Refine Investment —

Own metrics for newly acquired trading users, first-trade conversion, active traders, retention, incremental trading volume, and revenue contribution, taking acquisition, incentive, and delivery costs into account. Separate the effects of market conditions, incentives, and product improvements. Review growth initiatives and feature investments, reallocate resources based on results, and track connection success and trading reliability as measures of experience quality.

What We Look For In You

•

Relevant product management experience in trading, fintech, or digital assets, with a track record of measurable product growth. You can explain how you identified opportunities, developed a growth strategy, and improved acquisition, trading conversion, retention, or revenue, including your personal contribution and results.

•

A deep understanding of TradingView users and their practical use of charts, indicators, watchlists, alerts, and trading workflows. You can explain why different traders choose a platform, switch terminals, abandon an order, or continue using a service, and validate those insights through research and data.

•

Strong commercial judgment and growth strategy skills. You can segment customers, assess opportunities, define differentiated positioning, select distribution channels, and build business cases. You validate demand and a credible path to growth through research and focused experiments before substantial engineering investment.

•

Strong analytical and experimentation skills. You can analyze funnels, cohorts, and retention, design and evaluate growth experiments, and assess incrementality, acquisition cost, customer value, and incentive cost. You can distinguish short-term trading volume changes from sustainable growth.

•

An understanding of trading products and their commercial drivers. You are familiar with spot and derivatives fundamentals and how instrument coverage, fees, liquidity, execution quality, and account and position workflows influence customer choice, conversion, and retention. You can translate these factors into product decisions.

•

Experience delivering products that involve technical integration. You have worked with engineers on API or third-party platform integrations and can read interface documentation, understand account authorization and market data, order, and position synchronization, define business rules and acceptance criteria, and drive testing and launch. You connect technical constraints and implementation scope to user value and growth objectives.

•

Strong English communication and cross-functional execution skills. You can work with TradingView partners, marketing, regional, product, and engineering teams on business opportunities, product priorities, and technical feasibility, aligning resources around shared outcomes.

Nice-To-Haves

•

Experience growing a business within TradingView or a comparable trading-tool ecosystem, with examples spanning opportunity discovery, growth validation, and scaling.

•

Experience with trader communities, creators, educational content, partnerships, or channel growth, with the ability to evaluate initiatives by active traders, retention, and revenue contribution.

•

Experience growing products across regions or trader segments, with an understanding of differences in user behavior, customer propositions, and acquisition approaches.

•

Experience with TradingView Broker Integration, Advanced Charts, Trading Platform, or comparable integrations, with an ability to explain how the work improved the user experience or supported growth objectives.

What Success Looks Like

•

An evidence-based growth plan that identifies priority customer segments, OKX's differentiated value, promising distribution channels, and the business opportunity.

•

Validated, repeatable approaches to acquisition, trading conversion, and retention, supported by research and focused experiments that guide engineering investment and resource allocation.

•

Measurable, sustainable growth in active traders, retention, and revenue contribution, with acquisition and incentive costs taken into account.

•

Delivery of the product capabilities and TradingView integrations needed to capture validated opportunities, with improvements to critical user journeys and ongoing measurement of their growth impact.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

• L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

• Wellness and meal allowances

• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

• More that we love to tell you along the process!

A junior Controls Analyst sits in the second line and does the groundwork that keeps the control environment visible — maintaining the inventory, gathering evidence, testing controls.

Core responsibilities

Risk and control framework

•

Maintain the approved control inventory, including control descriptions, owners, frequency and evidence requirements; process additions through the agreed governance process.

•

Map controls to processes, risks and applicable obligations. Identify control gaps, duplicate controls, outdated records and missing ownership for review.

•

Support Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) cycles by collecting inputs, checking completeness and recording changes to risks, controls and action plans.

Evidence and control testing

•

Request and organise evidence from control owners across departments, maintain an accessible audit trail and follow up on overdue submissions.

•

Perform sample-based second-line testing under an approved test plan, assessing control design and operating effectiveness as applicable.

•

Document the test scope, sample, evidence, results and conclusion. Distinguish control failures from cases that cannot be tested because evidence is unavailable, and escalate material findings.

Issues and remediation

•

Record control deficiencies and agreed actions with clear descriptions, owners, due dates and status; follow up on overdue or recurring issues.

•

Review evidence of completed actions and, where required, retest before recommending closure. Escalate unresolved matters through the agreed process.

Cross-department control monitoring dashboards

•

Build and maintain dashboards that monitor key controls across departments against agreed thresholds, including control performance, overdue evidence, testing exceptions, open issues and remediation timeliness.

•

Work with risk and control owners to document approved indicators, thresholds, data sources, review frequency and escalation triggers. Check that dashboard data is consistent, complete and traceable to the underlying records.

•

Monitor threshold breaches and adverse trends, investigate anomalies with control owners, and escalate exceptions with clear context and action status through periodic risk reports and governance meetings.

GRC records and audit support

•

Keep risk, control, process, evidence and issue records current in the GRC tool; run data quality checks and prepare standard reporting extracts.

•

Prepare relevant records and evidence for internal audit, external audit and regulatory reviews in coordination with the wider team.

•

Attention to the details and result oriented

Strong Excel skills, including the ability to consolidate and check data, use formulas and pivot tables, and build clear dashboards or management reports.

Ability to understand process flows and risk and control relationships, apply a defined testing method, and write clear findings supported by evidence.

Eightcap operates at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and global financial markets. Headquartered in Melbourne with a global footprint spanning the UK, Cyprus, and Bulgaria, we build the high-performance infrastructure that connects the world to CFD markets - reliably, securely and with precision.
We are seeking a Junior Account Manager to support Eightcap’s growth by helping convert leads into active traders and expanding our footprint within the Chinese-speaking market. This is an early-career role: you will work alongside experienced Account Managers, learn the full lead-to-client journey, and take on more ownership as you grow, with training and support from the team.
Key Responsibilities:
• Lead Conversion & Pipeline Growth: Follow up on warm leads and help convert them into active traders, working towards agreed monthly KPIs and targets with guidance from senior team members.
• Educational Support: Start by guiding clients on how to use Eightcap’s trading platforms and tools (such as account set-up, platform navigation and basic features), and gradually assist with preparing and delivering educational materials, webinars and seminars (online and offline) as your experience grows.
• Lead Management: Help build and manage a robust pipeline, keeping lead records accurate and up to date, and support relevant communication channels, including company social media accounts, in line with compliance guidelines.
• Market Knowledge: Build a solid understanding of financial markets, and learn to clearly explain market news, trading products and Eightcap’s value proposition to a diverse audience.
• Client Relationship Management: Provide a premium customer experience by handling feedback, requests and basic technical queries promptly and professionally, escalating to senior colleagues where needed.
• Operational Excellence: Prioritise daily tasks and meet deadlines within a fast-paced team environment, helping ensure a seamless transition from lead to active client.
• Internal & External Stakeholders: Work with internal teams, including Marketing, Compliance and Engineering, and support relationships with retail clients, wholesale traders and external vendors to help deliver a seamless end-to-end client experience.
Requirements

• Native or professional fluency in Mandarin is required, along with good working English (spoken and written); Cantonese is highly regarded.
• 0–2 years’ experience in client service, business development or a similar customer-facing role; recent graduates are welcome to apply.
• A genuine interest in FX, CFDs and global financial markets, with a willingness to learn and the curiosity to connect market trends to client opportunities.
• An interest in client acquisition and business development, with enthusiasm for building relationships and turning conversations into long-term clients.
• A natural talent for engaging and persuading people, with strong communication skills, commercial instinct and the drive to win clients’ trust.
• A results-driven, motivated professional with a passion for high performance and a commitment to delivering a premium client experience.
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritise tasks in a fast-paced environment.
• A proactive problem solver who thinks analytically and stays calm under pressure.
• A deep respect for diversity and the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders from multicultural backgrounds.
• A coachable approach, with the initiative to ask questions, take feedback on board and grow quickly.
• A background in telemarketing or professional call centres is considered a plus.
Benefits

We have built a performance-driven environment where you’re given the autonomy to drive change and the accountability to own the results. We provide a space for the ambitious, adaptable and collaborative to deliver outcomes that fuel our success while building the skills and experience that defines a career.
We also support you through:
• Ongoing investment in your career development, including technical and professional training.
• Wellness and lifestyle perks, such as monthly corporate massages.
• Drinks every Friday.
• Parental leave entitlements.
• Staff referral bonus programme.
• Annual flu vaccinations.
• Purchased leave.
• Novated leasing options for vehicle financing and management.
• A great CBD location with easy access to public transport.
• A multicultural, collaborative and supportive team culture.
• Being part of exciting new projects for the company.
• Regular social activities.
